The cited definition only gives idempotence, image, and O(rho+epsilon) left/right-compression estimates for the compression constructed in the ambient algebra at hand; it does not prove that this construction commutes with amplification. Establishing I_n tensor Co_{P,Q}=Co_{I_n tensor P,I_n tensor Q} is a separate amplification-naturality result, and it is neither a validated child nor one of the shard's two allowed dependencies. Without that missing identification, C_lm(Y_lm)=Y_lm for Y_lm in M_n tensor S_{P_l,P_m}, the uniform bound on ||C_jk||, and the O(e) mismatched-corner estimate do not follow (a merely bounded level-one operator need not have uniformly bounded amplifications).
